subject: Centenarian Gut Microbes Yield Synthetic Bacteria That Restore Youthful Metabolism in Mice
script: From Agewell Brief: Centenarian Gut Microbes Yield Synthetic Bacteria That Restore Youthful Metabolism in Mice. UC San Diego researchers tracked the small-molecule outputs of human centenarian gut microbes and used engineered bacteria to reverse metabolic decay in aged mice. Human longevity has long posed a biological puzzle. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
